headings.usage: Main hero text, section titles, elegant ornate accents

accents.usage: Overlines, dates, small caps, button text

typography.notes: Use old-style figures for numerals where supported by the font. Typography must have real character; high-contrast serif display.

base.description: Base background for ALL sections. Must never be flat white. Acts as manuscript paper.

primary.description: Primary accent for borders, linework, cursors, and icons.

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtly embossed paper texture + fine paper-grain/noise overlay (opacity 3-5%) layered over #FBF3E7 on EVERY section.
visual_enhancers.parallax_murals: Large, low-opacity (5-10%) Kerala mural backgrounds varying per section. Use mix-blend-multiply and sepia/grayscale filters to blend into parchment.
visual_enhancers.ambient_motion: Near-constant ambient drifting gold particles, breathing glow on ornamental borders, looping shimmer on gold linework.
visual_enhancers.borders: Kerala mural art scrollwork borders as SVG line-art dividers. No boxy white rounded cards with drop-shadows.
motifs: Ornate Malankara/St. Thomas Cross as detailed gold linework centerpiece
Twisted gold rope/cord motif (from monogram) as recurring structural thread
Minnu (wedding chain), Manthrakodi (bridal shawl), nilavilakku (oil lamps) as line-art icons
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom animated gold cursor with trailing halo
visual_enhancers.scroll_progress_1: 'The Golden Thread': Twisted gold rope entwined with flower garland down one edge, blooming flowers at section anchors.
visual_enhancers.scroll_progress_2: 'Two Rings': Two ornate gold rings top-left and top-right that slowly rotate and converge to interlock above names at footer.

layouts.container: Maximalist, deeply layered. Do NOT leave sections visually empty.
layouts.spacing: Generous vertical padding (py-24 or py-32) but visually filled with ornamental borders, watermarks, and mural background layers.
layouts.cards: Avoid standard HTML boxy cards. Use intricate SVG frames, 'manuscript plates', or painted borders for content containment.

header.description: Slim, semi-transparent sticky gold nav appearing after hero scroll. Config-driven from section-visibility.

hero.description: Monogram SVG-rope-draw reveal + light-sweep shimmer + names/date fade-in. Deep malachite green 'A & M' with gold edging.
hero.assets: /monogram.png (ensure high-res display) or trace as SVG for the rope draw.

invitation_note.description: Hosea 2:19-20 verse. Features the ornate St. Thomas Cross centerpiece.
invitation_note.layout: Centered, flanked by heavy manuscript borders.

the_couple.interaction: 3D-tilt hover (use framer-motion or react-parallax-tilt), gold frame glow, light-sweep effect on hover.

the_journey.layout: Single flowing gold rope ribbon path emerging along scroll-scrubbed path.
the_journey.actions: Map link + Add-to-Calendar (Google + .ics menu) rendered in gold linework.

countdown.typography: Custom numeral typography (Cinzel/Old-style figures) flanked by mural border.

dress_code.description: Fabric-swatch chips representing the two family color directions (Groom: rose/lavender, Bride: teal/blue).
dress_code.style: Textured fabric aesthetic, deep jewel-toned silk vibes.

interactive_games.the_crowning: Drag gold crowns onto couple silhouettes -> reveal 'Crowned in grace and joy' copy.
interactive_games.light_the_lamps: Tap nilavilakku (oil lamps) to progressively illuminate Song of Solomon 8:6-7.
interactive_games.piece_it_together: SVG-clip-path jigsaw of gallery photo -> reveals wedding date.

rsvp.description: Form (Name + Guest Count only) stored in backend.

footer.description: Closing with names, date, best-compliments credit (Joel Koshy, Steve S George), monogram watermark.
footer.background: Deep bottle green (#1C2B24) or oxblood (#3A1220) with gold text.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React (JS ONLY, NO TSX), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide React (or custom SVGs for specific motifs).
critical_rules: NO TSX files. Use .js and .jsx extensions strictly.
NEVER use generic emoji icons. Use custom SVG line-art or highly stylized icons.
NEVER leave a section visually empty. ALWAYS add the paper noise texture and a low-opacity mural background layer.
NEVER use generic boxy white rounded cards with drop-shadows. Contain content inside SVG frames or painted borders.
NEVER use flat single-color backgrounds. Always layer `#FBF3E7` + texture + mural + vignettes.
DO NOT use Inter, Poppins, Playfair Display, or Roboto. Stick strictly to Cormorant Garamond, Spectral, and Cinzel.
Ensure scroll interactions (Golden Thread, Two Rings) use Framer Motion's `useScroll` and `useTransform` hooks.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="rsvp-submit-button"`).
DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds behind text if it overlays an image. Use glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-md bg-ivory-parchment/70`) to ensure readability.
Maintain a royal, MAXIMALIST, and reverent tone throughout the entire build.
Build custom SVG paths for the St. Thomas Cross, twisted gold rope, and nilavilakku.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where overlays are needed.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable, BUT fill that space with maximalist ornamentation.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
